dataset: TAPS: Throat and Acoustic Paired Speech Dataset (Korean)

synthetic_pipeline_smoke.note: Synthetic signals validate the analysis path only; they are not TAPS observations.

limitations: No empirical TAPS waveform was downloaded or analyzed.
Synthetic smoke statistics are not empirical speech findings.
Envelope maxima are observation landmarks, not validated hidden-state transitions or phonetic events.
Clock-scale shape invariance is conditional on a fixed event set and consistent scaling of observer time resolution.
